description: Create a new custom data table (schema: name + typed columns) in your Final organization. USE THIS for any data the app must keep — loyalty stamps, waitlists, bookings, inventory logs, settings: the platform syncs the table to every station running the flow and keeps it working offline at the POS, so it replaces ANY browser-storage or hand-rolled persistence (localStorage/IndexedDB are forbidden and fail validate_flow). NEVER store credentials in a table — that's what the secrets vault (request_secret) is for. This creates the table IMMEDIATELY and ORG-WIDE (visible to every station and every flow, not just this one), so unless the user actually asked for stored data, confirm before creating; creation can also be plan-gated — surface a plan/permission error to the user rather than retrying. Check list_custom_tables first to reuse an existing table, and search_blueprints before building functionality around a new one: a selfPersisting blueprint brings its OWN tables by exact name and apply_blueprint_widgets provisions them for you, so a lookalike would sit dead while the feature keeps reading the real one. Create tables only for net-new data no applied blueprint persists. The name is normalized to kebab-case; generated code reads/writes rows via renderClient.getCustomTableData / upsertCustomTableData.

referenceLinkedCollection.description: Foreign-key target collection (e.g. another custom table's kebab-case name).

referenceLinkedField.description: Foreign-key target field within that collection.

hubToken.description: Organization JWT fallback, only if the hub rejects your API key for this route.

name.description: Table name; normalized to a kebab-case id, e.g. 'gift-cards'.

name: flow_create_custom_table
